name: asset-evidence
title: Asset evidence sheet
for_each: select id,code from assets order by code

sections.title: Monthly depreciation
sections.sql: select period,amount_cents,closing_cents,location from depreciation where asset_id=$1 order by period

sections.title: History
sections.sql: select kind,actor,detail,created_at from events where asset_id=$1 order by created_at,id

name: depreciation-journal
title: Depreciation journal proposal
for_each: select id,period::text name from runs order by period

sections.title: Reviewed batch
sections.sql: select c.name company,c.currency,r.period,r.actor,r.reviewer,r.reason from runs r join companies c on c.id=r.company_id where r.id=$1

sections.title: Debit depreciation expense; credit accumulated depreciation
sections.note: Amounts are equal debit and credit proposals. Nothing is posted to a general ledger. Map your account codes before use.
sections.sql: select a.code,a.name,c.currency,d.amount_cents debit_cents,d.amount_cents credit_cents,d.closing_cents from depreciation d join assets a on a.id=d.asset_id join companies c on c.id=a.company_id where d.run_id=$1 order by a.code

name: disposal-approval
title: Disposal approval record
for_each: select d.id,a.code from disposals d join assets a on a.id=d.asset_id

sections.title: Disposal
sections.sql: select a.code,a.name,c.currency,d.disposed_on,d.proceeds_cents,d.carrying_cents,d.proceeds_cents-d.carrying_cents gain_loss_cents,d.actor,d.reviewer,d.evidence_ref,d.reason from disposals d join assets a on a.id=d.asset_id join companies c on c.id=a.company_id where d.id=$1
